smallestPermittedInLeaseCorrection: The same sole worker may make one scoped in-lease harness correction that establishes an exact reviewed dependency-resolution path for all seven fixed commands before any setup attempt: stage (hash-bound, assertStageableRel-conforming) or read-only-bind the verified Linux dependency closure at the runner's staged repository node_modules location, and similarly provide the repository-local pnpm tooling entrypoint (scripts/pnpm.mjs plus scripts/tooling/node_modules/pnpm/bin/pnpm.cjs or equivalent hash-bound staging). No downloads, installs, new resources or credential/.runtime reads; the complete 44/1153 closure digest must still prove. Mechanism must be manifest/code-bound; a bare NODE_PATH claim is insufficient.
